svg.title: How AI Primitives Hub works
svg.desc: 1. Author creates primitives 2. Author validates, builds, and publishes 3. Organization hub governs 4. Browse the approved catalog 5. Install once, land everywhere 6. Lock versions in lockfiles

g.text: Agents, skills, MCP servers, plugins, prompts,
instructions, and hooks live in the author's own
$ ai-primitives-hub skill create · agent create · plugin create
Collections are validated, packed into a bundle,
and released as a version on GitHub, Artifactory,
$ ai-primitives-hub collection validate && ai-primitives-hub bundle build
The source is registered in hub-config.yml through
a reviewed pull request, and profiles pin approved
YAML · validated against the hub schema
Changes merge through a reviewed pull request and pass hub validate.
The VS Code extension and the CLI list only the
hub's approved bundles and profiles. Install one
Marketplace · VS Code extension or CLI
Lists only the hub's approved sources and profiles
Each bundle is written to the right folders and
formats for every IDE and agent CLI.
team-a-skills → each tool's own folders and formats
User and repository installs are both tracked in
committed so teammates replay the same versions.
Same versions for the whole team
